title: CrazySexyCool: The TLC Musical is packed with incredible performances...
transcript: I grew up on TLC's music. No scrubs, waterfalls, Unpretty. Those were the soundtrack to my teenage years. While I knew the hits, I didn't actually know much about TLC Story. So when Arena Stage invited me to the opening night of Crazy Sexy Cool, the TLC Musical, I hopped in the car and headed down for a little theater weekend in Washington, DC. And it ended up being the best few days. I stayed at the Pendry Hotel in the Wharf. It was directly across the street from the theater. It was so beautiful and in a great neighborhood. I grabbed pre show drinks at zoos before heading down the street to Station 4 for an incredible meal. And then it was time to get ready and head over to Arena Stage for opening night. From the moment I walked into the theater, you could tell this is going to be special. The excitement was in the air, and T bars and chili of TLC were in the A building. They immediately got a standing ovation. Now, Crazy Sexy Cool is a bio jukebox musical. It tells the story of TLC, but this goes so much deeper than just their rise to fame. It's the story of their friendship, their creative battles, their financial hardships, their heartbreaks and medical challenges, and of course, the unimaginable loss they endured. The three women who lead the show are just phenomenal. They have incredible chemistry. They capture the energy and the humor. And the heart of TLC. The choreography was everything. I'm so glad I got to see this world premiere musical. It was definitely worth the trip. What an incredible evening. This is insane. Amazing costumes, amazing wigs. I had such a good time. Crazy, Sexy, Cool. Is currently running through August 9th at Arena Stage. Don't miss it.
